model: Frozen procedural-v2-duel-reply-score-768-audit.pt; no retraining, no threshold search on new maps
candidate: Generate the usual beam-256 ranked slate of up to eight distinct completed turns. Select the frozen model's highest-scored candidate only if its scalar score exceeds static rank zero by at least 0.06; otherwise keep static rank zero. The 0.06 threshold is the lower boundary of the top 25% of predicted overrides on fit maps seed6280000..6280767, where native reply outcomes were292 better/145 worse/41 same, grouped independent maps169 better/67 worse/55 same. This is in-sample selection, not a strength result.
arena: classic_generic_2022 procedural_v2 11x9 two-player reply-search-256/8/64 self-play, sample every fourth round
calibration_gate: Evaluate native reply-score better/worse/same versus static rank zero grouped by independent map and by both root seats. Proceed to the fresh offline window only if candidate-better maps exceed baseline-better maps and both seats have more better than worse positions. Do not change threshold or weights based on this result.
validation_gate: On the independent 256-map window require candidate-better maps > baseline-better maps with two-sided exact sign p<0.05, both seats more native better than worse positions, teacher-choice/first-action agreement not below static, and report changed-position count. This is only an offline conditional-opponent-score gate, not a complete-game or Elo claim.
promotion: Only after offline success, implement frozen inference in Rust and test fresh complete both-seat matched games grouped by independent map against plain beam-256 and reply-search-256/8/64, measure runtime and profile regressions. Seed6300000 final map window remains untouched during all offline selection.
resources: All compute on SSH server; inspect aggregate resources afresh, one bounded nice-19 CPU process, compressed per-shard outputs, no preemption or private data, GPU only if safely free.
